params.name: include
params.description: A list of comma-separated related models to include

items.docs: Gets the details of a single instance of a `Signin`.

params.name: location_ids
params.description: A comma separated list of Location IDs

params.name: with_colours
params.description:
A comma separated list of case-insensitive colour values.
i.e., `red`, `green`, `yellow`, and `orange`

params.name: query
params.description: Allows you to query by `company`, `email`, `first_name`, `last_name`, and `location_name`

params.name: with_acknowledged
params.description: Filters to all those `Signin`s that have, or have not been acknowledged

params.name: with_signed_in
params.description: Filters to all `Signin`s that are, or are not currently signed out.

params.name: signin_before
params.description: Filters results to all those *before* the provided datetime

params.name: signin_after
params.description: Filters results to all those *after* the provided datetime

params.name: limit
params.description: Limits the results to a specified number, defaults to 50

params.name: offset
params.description: Offsets the results to a specified number, defaults to 0

params.name: query_sort
params.description: Allows you to override ordering by most relevant results when querying

params.name: include
params.description: A list of comma-separated related models to include

params.name: include_anonymized
params.description: Set this flag to `true` to include anonymized signins in the response
